tex_content.html: \begin{equation} R^{ij}_{\ \ kl}(h_1)=e^{-2f}\bigl(R^{ij}_{\ \ kl}(h_0) -\widetilde f^i_{\ k}\delta ^j_{\ l}+\widetilde f^i_{\ l}\delta ^j_{\ k} +\widetilde f^j_{\ k}\delta ^i_{\ l}-\widetilde f^j_{\ l}\delta ^i_{\ k} -|\nabla f|^2(\delta ^i_{\ k}\delta ^j_{\ l}-\delta ^i_{\ l}\delta ^j_{\ k})\bigr), \end{equation} where $\widetilde f=\Hess (f)-df\otimes df$. Applying these formulas, the cylinder closeness, and (21) gives the two strict curvature improvements.
